title: A larger outline
hook: A defense can change the shape of a body.

doesNotKnow: Underwater, many pufferfish inflate defensively by taking in what?

misconception: The first explanation of an aquatic animal feature must be correct.
objective: Underwater, many pufferfish inflate defensively by taking in what?

claims.text: Underwater, many pufferfish inflate defensively by taking in what? The two panels show a compact outline and a larger inflated outline. Many pufferfish can rapidly take in water to inflate. This defense is stressful and the schematic does not depict a measured fish or recommend handling one.
claims.source: Source lead, not checked: NOAA Fisheries, fish anatomy and behavior, https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/

claims.text: The two panels are simplified schematics, not observations or measurements.
A pufferfish is underwater when it inflates. Which surrounding substance can it take in for inflation? Many pufferfish inflate underwater by taking in water.
claims.source: Source lead, not checked: NOAA Fisheries, fish anatomy and behavior, https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/
